gradient_method: Exact chain rule at interior point of each exact activation region

plots.title: Prediction error
plots.description: Red means predicted too high; blue means too low. Both colors use the same scale. Measured across the input square; no values clipped.

plots.title: Surface steepness
plots.description: Dark pieces are flat; bright pieces are steep. Each piece uses the exact slope of its model plane. Color compresses the large range so gentle slopes remain visible; no values clipped.

plots.title: Size of each flat piece
plots.description: Every colored shape is an actual model piece: 7,097 in all. Dark means small, light means large; color uses a log scale.
